clips.title: The story
paras: In Deathknell, David Trias trains the newly awakened Forsaken. He teaches stealth and bladecraft so they can serve Queen Sylvanas and the Forsaken.

David Trias trains newly risen undead among Deathknell’s tombstones and ruins. He seeks those with a talent for killing unseen. For the fledgling Forsaken, survival calls for more than strength at arms; it calls for precise strikes from the dark. Trias deciphers orders and teaches initiates to wield daggers, hide their movements, and use their reanimated reflexes with lethal precision against the living and the Scourge.
